comments.content:
Perhaps we can use the tutorial message in the `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR_GREETING_MESSAGE` variable?
```
Welcome to the ubiquity-dollar repository. Please comment "/assign" on any issue if you would like to work on it. UbiquiBot will immediately assign you to the issue. Please comment "/wallet" at any time with your wallet address following (e.g. /wallet ubq.eth) to register your payment address for task completion.
```
There are no any special thoughts under this requirement. At that time some of the bot's commands started with the author tag so it felt to be normal to start greeting with the author's tag.
Then it seems reasonable to show nothing

# Specification
The two business problems to solve are: 
1. a custom message that partners can use to greet new hunters
2. show a list of all of the bot commands that the new hunter can invoke.
We must create new config properties: 
- [ ] `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR_GREETING_HEADER`: string;
- [ ] `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR_GREETING_HELP_MENU`: boolean;
- [ ] `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR_GREETING_FOOTER`: string;
Post the header first, then the help menu, and lastly the footer in a single "first time contributor greeting" comment.
- [ ] Be sure to also update the README.md with these config properties.
# Example Input
```
FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR_GREETING_HEADER="Thank you for contributing to UbiquiBot! Please be sure to set your wallet address before completing your first bounty so that the automatic payout upon task completion will work for you."
FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR_GREETING_HELP_MENU=true
FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR_GREETING_FOOTER="###### Also please star this repository and [@ubiquity/devpool-directory](https://github.com/ubiquity/devpool-directory/) to show your support. It helps a lot!"
```
# Example Output
Thank you for contributing to UbiquiBot! Please be sure to set your wallet address before completing your first bounty so that the automatic payout upon task completion will work for you. 
```
- /assign: Assign the origin sender to the issue automatically.
- /unassign: Unassign the origin sender from the issue automatically.
- /help: List all available commands.
- /payout: Disable automatic payment for the issue.
- /multiplier: Set bounty multiplier (for treasury)
- /allow: Set access control. (Admin Only)
- /wallet: <WALLET_ADDRESS | ENS_NAME>: Register the hunter's wallet address. 
  ex1: /wallet 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266 
  ex2: /wallet vitalik.eth
```
###### Also please star this repository and [@ubiquity/devpool-directory](https://github.com/ubiquity/devpool-directory/) to show your support. It helps a lot!
